verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a full REST API, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. A probe of the standard OpenAPI and Swagger paths on the docs site returned 404 for every candidate. Having a REST API, an MCP server, and llms.txt is adjacent to this story and does not deliver a downloadable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
